headline: Nearly 8 million people watched GTA VI livestreams at the same time, four times the old record
label: VIRAL
caption:
The whole internet watched GTA VI at once. 📺

At its peak, about 7.9 million people were watching GTA VI livestreams at the same time across Twitch, YouTube and Kick, according to analytics firm Streams Charts.

Twitch had about 3.3 million viewers, YouTube about 3.2 million and Kick about 1.5 million.

The previous record for a game launch was about 1.74 million viewers, set by Valorant in 2020, so GTA VI beat it by more than four times.

Viewers watched more than 125 million hours of GTA VI streams on the first day alone.
